title: Presentation Layer
markdown:
The **Presentation Layer** (Layer 6) is concerned with the syntax and semantics of the information exchanged between two systems.

### Primary Responsibilities

- **Translation** — Converts data between sender-dependent formats and a common network format (e.g. ASCII to EBCDIC).
- **Encryption & Decryption** — Transforms sensitive data into secure cipher text for transmission and decrypts it at the receiver.
- **Compression** — Reduces the number of bits to be transmitted, optimizing bandwidth usage for text, images, and audio.
